text: VideoAgent APIs Document Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.6 Updated 2026-11-06 Base path /api/v1 Authentication HttpOnly Session Cookie Request format JSON with credentials: "include" API style REST with job polling Billable generation Explicit approval plus Idempotency-Key Write protection Same-origin Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site validation User credits Internal per-user quota with an auditable ledger Administration VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS allowlist OpenAPI /docs and /openapi.json Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1 Interactive OpenAPI documentation is available at: http://localhost:8000/docs http://localhost:8000/openapi.json All endpoints require authentication except /health , /auth/register , /auth/login , /auth/registration-policy , and /shares/{token}/content . Browser clients must send the session cookie for authenticated endpoints. Authentication The API uses an HttpOnly session cookie named videoagent session . Browser clients must send requests with credentials enabled. Register POST /auth/register { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters", "locale": "zh-CN", "invite code": "optional-invite-code" } Registration Policy GET /auth/registration-policy Returns open , invite , or closed . Invite mode requires invite code . Login POST /auth/login { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters" } Current User GET /auth/me Returns the authenticated user's ID, email, locale, and creation time. Update Locale PATCH /auth/me { "locale": "en" } Logout POST /auth/logout Revokes the current session and removes the session cookie. Health GET /health Returns API status and database dependency health. A database failure returns 503 with status: "degraded" . Projects All project endpoints require authentication and are scoped to the current user. Another user's project returns 404 . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /projects List active projects POST /projects Create a project GET /projects/{project id} Read a project PATCH /projects/{project id} Rename a project DELETE /projects/{project id} Archive a project GET /workspace List project folders and all recent conversations POST /workspace/folders Create a project folder PATCH /workspace/folders/{folder id} Rename a project folder DELETE /workspace/folders/{folder id} Delete a folder without deleting conversations PUT /workspace/threads/{project id}/folder File or unfile a conversation Create request: { "title": "Launch film", "brief": "A ten-second cinematic product launch" } Rename request: { "title": "Launch film — final" } Storyboards Read Storyboard GET /projects/{project id}/storyboard Replace Storyboard PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard { "characters": [ { "name": "Mara", "description": "A reserved photographer in her early thirties.", "prompt en": "Editorial portrait with stable identity and natural skin texture", "prompt zh": "稳定身份与自然肤质的角色定妆照" } ], "scenes": [ { "name": "Studio", "location": "Downtown loft", "description": "A warm production loft with large windows.", "prompt en": "Cinematic production loft with warm daylight", "prompt zh": "暖日光下的电影感制作空间" } ], "shots": [ { "description": "Opening product reveal", "prompt en": "Cinematic product reveal with warm rim light", "prompt zh": "暖色轮廓光下的电影感产品亮相", "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "16:9", "generation mode": "text to video" } ] } Reorder Storyboard PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/order The request must contain every current Shot exactly once. Reordering preserves Shot IDs, generated assets, generation history, and project continuity. { "shot ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" ] } Save Storyboard Version POST /projects/{project id}/versions { "label": "Director approved" } GET /projects/{project id}/versions lists immutable snapshot metadata. POST /projects/{project id}/versions/{version id}/restore restores the snapshot and returns the updated Storyboard. Snapshots include all Characters, Scenes, and Shots; they do not modify exported FinalCuts. VideoAgent Conversation List Messages GET /projects/{project id}/messages Send Message POST /projects/{project id}/messages { "content": "Turn the brief into a three-shot launch film", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } The response includes the user message, VideoAgent reply, and updated storyboard as JSON. The response also includes the current approval stage. Observe Agent Activity GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} Returns ordered activity events for the run: { "items": [ { "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020", "sequence": 1, "kind": "context", "label": "Assembled working context", "detail": "locale=en · workflow=concept/awaiting approval", "status": "completed", "created at": "2026-11-05T08:00:00Z" } ] } Activity kinds are context , memory , skill , planning , validation , state , and reply . The workspace polls this endpoint while waiting so the trace reflects actual execution rather than decorative animation. Read Workflow GET /projects/{project id}/workflow The workflow progresses through concept , outline , script , and ready . concept establishes the creative direction, outline defines episodes and shots, and script develops the scene-level production text. Generation is only enabled after the script is approved and the state becomes ready . Submit Workflow Decision POST /projects/{project id}/workflow/decision { "choice": "approve", "instruction": null, "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } choice is approve , refine , or custom . Refinements preserve the current stage. An approval advances one stage and creates the next refinement level. Generation Estimate Cost POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate Generate Shot POST /shots/{shot id}/generate Required header: Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id Request: { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to video", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "reference asset ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011" ], "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-video-v4 0", "resolution": "1080p", "audio enabled": true, "task type": "reference" } generation mode is text to video or image to video . Image-to-video requires a project-owned image asset that belongs to the current user. Estimation and generation return 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED until the storyboard contains at least one Character and one Scene. provider and model are optional per-task overrides. Omit both to use the project default. Changing the override invalidates the previous estimate. reference asset ids accepts up to 15 ordered project image, video, or audio assets. Image-to-video also accepts the legacy reference asset id field. Providers that support multimodal references receive the ordered media set; task type is auto , reference , edit , or extend . Character Image Generation Method Path Purpose --- --- --- POST /characters/{character id}/estimate Estimate character image credits POST /characters/{character id}/assets Upload a character image POST /characters/{character id}/generate Generate or edit a character image Generation request: { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to image", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-image-v3 0" } generation mode is text to image or image to image . A successful request returns an AssetRead whose content can be previewed and downloaded through content url . The estimate endpoint accepts optional provider and model fields so the estimate follows the same image-model selection used by generation. Scene Editing and References PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/scenes/{scene id} updates name, location, description, or prompts. POST /scenes/{scene id}/assets uploads a scene reference image. The returned asset filename is namespaced to the scene so the workspace can keep it under that Scene directory. POST /scenes/{scene id}/estimate and POST /scenes/{scene id}/generate run scene text-to-image or image-to-image generation. The request accepts the same provider and model overrides as Character generation. Job Status GET /jobs/{job id} Possible statuses include submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , and cancelled . Each successful generation reserves the estimated credits from the current user's VideoAgent balance. An immediate submission failure or a later failed or cancelled job returns the reservation through an idempotent refund entry. Credits GET /credits Returns the authenticated user's internal VideoAgent quota. This balance is separate from the server-owned Provider account pool. { "provider": "video agent", "connected": true, "credits": 95 } Skills Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /skills List public Skills and Skills owned by the current user POST /skills Persist a structured Skill POST /skills/optimize Convert a rough capability idea into a structured draft POST /skills/engagement/query Read signals for up to 100 stable Skill keys POST /skills/engagement/like Toggle a like for a stable Skill key POST /skills/engagement/use Record one de-duplicated use signal The optimizer returns a stable skill id , title, description, detailed instructions, starter prompt, and input/output JSON schemas. List responses add is mine , likes , uses , and is liked . Engagement endpoints accept {"skill key":"<user id /<skill id "} , which allows bundled and published Skills to share one persistent signal store. Authors cannot like their own Skill; repeated requests from the same account do not inflate either counter. { "skill key": "video agent/creator vlog" } POST /skills/engagement/query accepts {"skill keys":["<user id /<skill id "]} and returns a keyed items object. This lets the client hydrate engagement for built-in Skills that are not rows in the user Skill table. { "idea": "Turn product stills into premium campaign videos", "title": "Editorial product film", "locale": "en" } Videos Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /hots List published community videos; mine=true filters to the current user POST /hots Upload an MP4 and publish a community post POST /hots/{post id}/like Toggle the current user's like GET /hots/{post id}/video Stream the public video POST /hots uses multipart/form-data with file , title , prompt , and skill . The uploaded video asset is public and appears in the authenticated author's Assets view. Videos responses include is liked ; one account contributes at most one like, and authors cannot like their own post. Production Progress GET /projects/{project id}/progress Returns the live production percentage used by the workspace progress bar. It tracks the workflow stage and completed Shots; it is readiness, not a visual quality score. Final Cut Visual Review GET /projects/{project id}/visual-review/models Returns the configured visual evaluator models. POST /projects/{project id}/visual-review { "asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000030", "model": "vision-model", "metrics": [ "character consistency", "style consistency", "prompt alignment", "temporal stability" ] } The endpoint accepts only an exported Final Cut asset, extracts representative frames, and sends them to the selected configured vision model. It returns paper-style or trained-model consistency metrics with evidence. When no evaluator is configured, the API returns 503 VISUAL REVIEW UNAVAILABLE instead of fabricating scores. Assets and Media Media endpoints are scoped to the authenticated user. Unsupported content types, invalid file signatures, and files above the configured size limit are rejected before an Asset record is created. Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /assets List the current user's assets GET /projects/{project id}/assets List assets for one owned project POST /projects/{project id}/assets Upload image, video, or audio media PATCH /assets/{asset id} Rename an owned asset DELETE /assets/{asset id} Soft-delete an owned asset GET/PUT /projects/{project id}/asset-selections Read or update final asset choices GET /assets/{asset id}/content Download or preview a private asset POST /projects/{project id}/exports Compose and export the current film POST /assets/{asset id}/share Create a time-limited share link POST /hots/from-asset/{asset id} Publish an existing exported final cut POST /projects/{project id}/collaborations Create a project collaboration link POST /collaborations/{token}/accept Accept an invite and join the project DELETE /shares/{share id} Revoke a share link GET /shares/{token}/content Read a valid shared asset without a session Upload request: POST /projects/{project id}/assets Content-Type: multipart/form-data file=<image, video, or audio Project uploads accept an optional shot id form field. The returned asset UUID is the stable ID used in prompts as @<asset-id . Export request: { "aspect ratios": ["21:9", "16:9", "9:16", "1:1"], "soundtrack asset id": null, "captions": "A generated product story", "permission": "private" } The export response contains delivery Assets and a generated cover. Export requires every storyboard Shot to have a generated result. The current implementation composes those generated shots with FFmpeg, normalizes each delivery ratio, applies a short crossfade between shots, and optionally includes captions and an uploaded soundtrack. One request may return up to four delivery variants; each non-empty caption line is timed evenly across the assembled cut. Share request: { "expires in hours": 24 } Share tokens are random, stored as hashes, expire after the requested period, and can be revoked. Access increments an audit counter. Collaboration request: { "permission": "edit", "collaborator email": "editor@example.com", "expires in hours": 168 } Collaboration links are distinct from asset-share links. They grant project membership after authenticated acceptance and enforce view or edit permission on project endpoints. Administration Administration endpoints require an authenticated account whose email appears in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . Other users receive 403 ADMIN ACCESS REQUIRED . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /admin/me Confirm administration access GET /admin/overview Counts and launch-state summary GET /admin/users Search users and read credits PATCH /admin/users/{id} Enable or disable an account POST /admin/users/{id}/credits Add or remove credits GET /admin/jobs Inspect generation jobs POST /admin/jobs/{id}/refund Refund a failed or uncertain hold GET/PATCH /admin/settings Read or update generation and registration GET/POST /admin/invites List or create invite codes DELETE /admin/invites/{id} Revoke an invite code GET /admin/audit Read administrative audit entries GET /admin/provider Read the active Provider connection state Settings update: { "generation enabled": false, "registration mode": "invite" } When generation is disabled, estimate and submit endpoints return 503 GENERATION DISABLED . Disabling an account revokes its Sessions immediately. Pippit Provider Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /providers/pippit Read server-owned Pippit account status GET /providers/pippit/credits Read the active Pippit credit balance Pippit authorization is server-owned. The API invokes the installed pippit-tool-cli binary; browser clients never receive access keys or CLI session files. Provider billing draws from the configured server account, while product users consume independent VideoAgent balances through /credits . Operators authorize the CLI on the API host before enabling live generation. GET /providers/pippit response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "scope": "server" } GET /providers/pippit/credits response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "credits": 42 } If the server CLI is not logged in, the credits endpoint returns connected: false and credits: null . A missing binary returns 503 ; an upstream CLI failure returns 502 . Kling Provider VideoAgent uses the server-owned China-region @klingai/cli-cn package and the https://klingai.com/mcp endpoint. Kling tokens never reach the browser. VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID pins the authorized domestic account. Operators can use kling who am i and kling account for read-only identity and credit checks. Model Catalogue Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /providers/models Public list of selectable video and image models Each item carries provider , model , label , display , and kind ( video or image ). The catalogue is the single source of truth for the workspace pickers and for resolving Provider/Label brief tags; operators extend it with VIDEOAGENT EXTRA MODELS and hide entries with VIDEOAGENT DISABLED MODELS . { "items": [ { "provider": "wanx", "model": "wan2.6-t2v", "label": "Wan 2.6", "display": "Wanx/Wan 2.6", "kind": "video" } ] } Wanx Provider Wanx runs over Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) instead of a local CLI. The server owns the key and clients only see provider: "wanx" . VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=wanx VIDEOAGENT WANX API KEY=sk-... VIDEOAGENT WANX BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com VIDEOAGENT WANX MODEL=wan2.6-t2v Setting VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=wanx without a key fails fast at startup with WanxNotConfigured . Job polling maps DashScope PENDING / RUNNING to running , SUCCEEDED to succeeded , and FAILED / CANCELED / UNKNOWN to failed ; result URLs expire after 24 hours and are downloaded immediately. See docs/tech/models.md for all providers. Errors Errors use the following shape: { "error": { "code": "PROJECT NOT FOUND", "message": "The project was not found.", "details": {}, "requestId": "request-id" } } Important status codes: Status Meaning --- --- 401 Authentication required or session expired 402 The user's VideoAgent credit balance is insufficient 403 Approval, administrator, registration, or invite policy denied 404 Resource not found or not owned by the current user 409 Configured provider is not active 413 Uploaded media exceeds the configured limit 422 Request validation failed 429 An auth, generation, or upload rate limit was exceeded 502 Upstream provider request failed 503 Provider CLI is unavailable or generation is paused

text: VideoAgent API 文档 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.6 更新日期 2026-11-06 基础路径 /api/v1 认证方式 HttpOnly Session Cookie 请求格式 JSON，并设置 credentials: "include" API 风格 REST + 任务轮询 计费生成 显式审批 + Idempotency-Key 写接口保护 同源 Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site 校验 用户积分 用户独立配额与可审计流水 管理权限 VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS 邮箱白名单 OpenAPI /docs 与 /openapi.json 本地 OpenAPI 文档： http://localhost:8000/docs http://localhost:8000/openapi.json 除 /health 、注册、登录、注册策略和公开分享内容外，所有接口都要求登录， 由需要鉴权的浏览器请求设置 credentials: "include" 。 健康检查 GET /health 返回 API 状态和数据库依赖状态。数据库异常时返回 503 ，并标记为 degraded 。 认证 注册 POST /auth/register { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters", "locale": "zh-CN", "invite code": "可选的邀请码" } 注册策略 GET /auth/registration-policy 返回 open 、 invite 或 closed 。邀请制下注册请求必须携带 invite code 。 登录 POST /auth/login { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters" } 当前用户 GET /auth/me 返回用户 ID、邮箱、语言偏好和创建时间。 更新语言偏好 PATCH /auth/me { "locale": "en" } 退出 POST /auth/logout 撤销当前 Session 并清除 Cookie。 项目 所有项目接口均校验当前用户所有权。访问其他用户的项目统一返回 404 。 方法 路径 说明 --- --- --- GET /projects 当前用户项目列表 POST /projects 创建项目 GET /projects/{project id} 读取项目 PATCH /projects/{project id} 重命名项目 DELETE /projects/{project id} 归档项目 GET /workspace 项目目录与全部历史对话 POST /workspace/folders 创建项目目录 PATCH /workspace/folders/{folder id} 重命名项目目录 DELETE /workspace/folders/{folder id} 删除目录但保留对话 PUT /workspace/threads/{project id}/folder 将对话收纳到目录或移出目录 创建项目： { "title": "产品发布片", "brief": "十秒电影感产品发布视频" } 重命名： { "title": "产品发布片 · 终版" } 故事板 读取 GET /projects/{project id}/storyboard 整体替换 PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard { "characters": [ { "name": "Mara", "description": "一位克制、敏锐的摄影师。", "prompt en": "Editorial portrait with stable identity and natural skin texture", "prompt zh": "稳定身份与自然肤质的角色定妆照" } ], "scenes": [ { "name": "Studio", "location": "Downtown loft", "description": "带落地窗和暖色日光的制作空间。", "prompt en": "Cinematic production loft with warm daylight", "prompt zh": "暖日光下的电影感制作空间" } ], "shots": [ { "description": "开场产品亮相", "prompt en": "Cinematic product reveal with warm rim light", "prompt zh": "暖色轮廓光下的电影感产品亮相", "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "16:9", "generation mode": "text to video" } ] } 镜头排序 PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/order 请求必须且只能包含当前全部 Shot 一次。排序会保留 Shot ID、生成资产、生成历史和项目 连续性。 { "shot ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" ] } 保存故事板版本 POST /projects/{project id}/versions { "label": "导演确认" } GET /projects/{project id}/versions 返回不可变快照的元数据； POST /projects/{project id}/versions/{version id}/restore 回滚指定快照并返回 更新后的 Storyboard。快照包含全部 Characters、Scenes 和 Shots，不会修改已经导出的 FinalCuts。 Agent 对话 消息历史 GET /projects/{project id}/messages 发送消息 POST /projects/{project id}/messages { "content": "把需求整理成三个镜头的发布视频", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } 响应包含用户消息、Assistant 回复、最新故事板和当前审批阶段。 观测 Agent 执行 GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} 返回该 run 的有序步骤： { "items": [ { "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020", "sequence": 1, "kind": "context", "label": "Assembled working context", "detail": "locale=zh-CN · workflow=concept/awaiting approval", "status": "completed", "created at": "2026-11-05T08:00:00Z" } ] } 活动类型为 context 、 memory 、 skill 、 planning 、 validation 、 state 和 reply 。工作区在等待回复时轮询该接口，展示真实执行步骤。 读取工作流 GET /projects/{project id}/workflow 工作流依次经过 concept 、 outline 、 script 和 ready 。 concept 确认整体 设定， outline 确认分集与分镜大纲， script 确认逐场剧本。只有剧本获批且状态 进入 ready 后才允许生成。 提交审批 POST /projects/{project id}/workflow/decision { "choice": "approve", "instruction": null, "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } choice 为 approve 、 refine 或 custom 。调整和自定义意见保持当前阶段； 批准会进入下一层细化。 制作进度 GET /projects/{project id}/progress 返回用于工作区进度条的实时制作百分比，依据工作流阶段和已完成 Shots 计算。 该值表示 readiness，不是视觉质量评分。 Final Cut 视觉评估 GET /projects/{project id}/visual-review/models 返回已配置的视觉评估模型。 POST /projects/{project id}/visual-review { "asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000030", "model": "vision-model", "metrics": [ "character consistency", "style consistency", "prompt alignment", "temporal stability" ] } 接口只接受导出的 Final Cut，提取代表性帧并调用所选视觉模型，返回带证据的 论文型或训练模型评估指标。未配置评估模型时返回 503 VISUAL REVIEW UNAVAILABLE ， 不会生成伪造分数。 视频生成 积分估算 POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate 提交生成 POST /shots/{shot id}/generate 必须携带： Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id 请求： { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to video", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "reference asset ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011" ], "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-video-v4 0", "resolution": "1080p", "audio enabled": true, "task type": "reference" } 未显式批准时返回 403 。相同镜头和幂等键重复请求会返回已有任务，不会再次提交 Provider。 generation mode 为 text to video 或 image to video ；图生视频必须引用当前用户、 当前项目中的有效图片资产。 故事板至少包含一个 Character 和一个 Scene 后，才允许镜头估算与生成；否则返回 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED 。 provider 与 model 是可选的任务级覆盖；同时省略时继承项目默认模型。切换模型会 使旧积分估算失效。 reference asset ids 最多接收 15 个有顺序的项目图片、视频或音频素材；图生视频仍兼容 旧的单素材字段 reference asset id 。支持多模态参考的 Provider 会按顺序接收素材； task type 可取 auto 、 reference 、 edit 、 extend 。 角色图片生成 方法 路径 用途 --- --- --- POST /characters/{character id}/estimate 估算角色图片生成积分 POST /characters/{character id}/assets 上传角色图片 POST /characters/{character id}/generate 生成或编辑角色图片 生成请求： { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to image", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-image-v3 0" } generation mode 为 text to image 或 image to image 。成功响应为 AssetRead ， 客户端可通过 content url 预览和下载生成图片。 估算接口同样接受可选的 provider 与 model ，确保估算与实际生成使用同一图片模型。 场景编辑与参考图 PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/scenes/{scene id} 可更新名称、地点、 描述和 Prompt。 POST /scenes/{scene id}/assets 上传场景参考图，返回素材名会绑定 Scene ID，工作区据此把图片放在对应 Scene 目录下。 POST /scenes/{scene id}/estimate 和 POST /scenes/{scene id}/generate 用于执行 场景文生图或图生图；请求接受与 Character 生成相同的 provider 、 model 覆盖。 查询任务 GET /jobs/{job id} 常见状态： pending submission uncertain submitted queued running succeeded failed cancelled 前端每 5 秒轮询任务状态。Celery Worker 同时轮询任务状态。 每次成功提交生成时，系统按估算值预留当前用户的 VideoAgent 积分。提交立即失败， 或任务后续进入失败、取消状态时，系统通过幂等退款流水返还预留积分。 用户积分 GET /credits 返回当前用户独立的 VideoAgent 配额。该余额与服务端 Provider 账户积分池分离。 { "provider": "video agent", "connected": true, "credits": 95 } Skill 方法 路径 说明 --- --- --- GET /skills 获取公开 Skill 和当前用户拥有的 Skill POST /skills 保存结构化 Skill POST /skills/optimize 将粗略能力想法整理成结构化草稿 POST /skills/engagement/query 批量读取最多 100 个稳定 Skill 标识的互动数据 POST /skills/engagement/like 切换稳定 Skill 标识的点赞状态 POST /skills/engagement/use 记录一次去重使用信号 优化接口返回稳定的 skill id 、名称、描述、详细执行规范、启动提示词以及输入和 输出 JSON Schema。列表响应增加 is mine 、 likes 、 uses 和 is liked 。 互动接口接收 {"skill key":"<user id /<skill id "} ，让内置 Skill 与用户发布 Skill 使用同一套持久统计。作者不能给自己的 Skill 点赞；同一账户重复请求不会重复 增加点赞数或使用数。 { "skill key": "video agent/creator vlog" } POST /skills/engagement/query 接收 {"skill keys":["<user id /<skill id "]} ， 并以 items 对象返回对应标识的互动数据，用于加载不在用户 Skill 表中的内置 Skill。 { "idea": "把产品静帧制作成高级广告视频", "title": "电影感产品广告", "locale": "zh-CN" } Videos 方法 路径 说明 --- --- --- GET /hots 获取社区视频； mine=true 仅返回当前用户发布 POST /hots 上传 MP4 并发布社区作品 POST /hots/{post id}/like 切换当前用户点赞状态 GET /hots/{post id}/video 播放公开视频 POST /hots 使用 multipart/form-data ，字段为 file 、 title 、 prompt 和 skill 。上传视频作为公开资产保存，并自动出现在作者的 Assets 中。Videos 响应包含 is liked ；同一账户最多贡献一次点赞，作者不能给自己的作品点赞。 资产与媒体 媒体接口均校验当前用户所有权。不支持的类型、文件头不匹配或超过大小限制的文件 会在创建 Asset 记录前被拒绝。 方法 路径 说明 --- --- --- GET /assets 当前用户资产列表 GET /projects/{project id}/assets 项目资产列表 POST /projects/{project id}/assets 上传图片、视频或音频素材 PATCH /assets/{asset id} 重命名当前用户素材 DELETE /assets/{asset id} 软删除当前用户素材 GET/PUT /projects/{project id}/asset-selections 读取或更新最终选用素材 GET /assets/{asset id}/content 读取私有资产内容 POST /projects/{project id}/exports 合成并导出当前成片 POST /assets/{asset id}/share 创建限时分享链接 POST /hots/from-asset/{asset id} 直接发布已导出的成片 POST /projects/{project id}/collaborations 创建项目协作链接 POST /collaborations/{token}/accept 接受邀请并加入项目 DELETE /shares/{share id} 撤销分享链接 GET /shares/{token}/content 通过有效分享链接读取资产 上传请求： POST /projects/{project id}/assets Content-Type: multipart/form-data file=<图片、视频或音频 项目上传可附带 shot id 表单字段，把参考图归入镜头。返回的素材 UUID 就是 Prompt 中使用的稳定 ID，格式为 @<asset-id 。 导出请求： { "aspect ratios": ["21:9", "16:9", "9:16", "1:1"], "soundtrack asset id": null, "captions": "一段产品故事", "permission": "private" } 导出响应包含交付版本 Asset 与自动生成的封面。只有全部故事板 Shot 均已生成结果时才可导出。 当前实现使用 FFmpeg 合成这些镜头， 统一交付比例，在镜头间添加短交叉淡化，并可加入字幕和上传的音轨。单次请求最多返回 四个交付版本；字幕按非空行均匀分配到成片时长。 分享请求： { "expires in hours": 24 } 分享 Token 随机生成且只保存哈希；链接支持过期与撤销，访问时累计审计计数。 协作请求： { "permission": "edit", "collaborator email": text: VideoAgent Models Document Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.0 Updated 2026-11-21 Scope Video generation providers, planner and vision review, media storage, configuration and troubleshooting This is the single entry point for provider documentation: video generation, LLM, visual review and media storage live here instead of being spread across files. 1. Overview Provider Transport Capabilities Auth Configuration prefix --- --- --- --- --- mock In-process Text-to-video, image-to-video (bundled sample media) None — pippit CLI subprocess Text/image-to-video, task queries, credit balance Server-owned CLI login VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT kling CLI or MCP Text/image-to-video, motion control, ordered multimodal references China-region CLI OAuth or per-user MCP token VIDEOAGENT KLING wanx HTTP (DashScope) Text/image-to-video, multi-shot narration Server API key VIDEOAGENT WANX The planner and visual review speak the OpenAI-compatible protocol (DeepSeek, Qwen, and others), and media storage has local and oss backends. Credentials only ever come from environment variables or .env ; they never enter the code or the repository. 2. Resolution order 1. VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER selects the default provider ( mock , pippit , kling , wanx ). 2. A Provider/Model tag in the project brief (for example Wanx/Wan 2.6 ) overrides it. 3. An explicit provider sent by the client during estimate or generation overrides both. 4. mock short-circuits to the in-process provider and touches no external service. 5. Under auto , an unconnected Kling falls back to Mock when fallback is allowed, and the UI says so. 2.1 Model catalogue and UI selection Models are no longer baked into the frontend: GET /api/v1/providers/models returns one catalogue ( provider , model , label , display , kind ). The workspace video and image pickers load it on mount and fall back to the bundled catalogue when the API is unreachable. Provider/Label tags in a project brief resolve through the same catalogue. Operators can change the catalogue without code: Append models (JSON array; kind is video or image) VIDEOAGENT EXTRA MODELS=[{"provider":"wanx","model":"wan2.2-t2v-plus","label":"Wan 2.2 Plus"}] Hide defaults by model id or "Provider/Label" VIDEOAGENT DISABLED MODELS=["kling-video-v2 5"] The static GitHub Pages landing site has no API and keeps the bundled catalogue. 2.2 Auto recommendation The composer's Auto no longer picks a model at project creation. At the shot stage the user fills in the options and the server recommends a model: Input Meaning --- --- generation mode text-to-video / image-to-video duration seconds 1–30 seconds aspect ratio 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 1:1, … reference image count number of reference images audio enabled whether audio is required preference budget , balanced , quality Routing first hard-filters by capability (mode, maximum duration, native ratio, reference slots, audio, provider availability), then scores the survivors by preference (cost, quality tier, parameter fit) and returns the best pick plus alternatives: { "recommended": { "provider": "wanx", "model": "wan2.7-t2v", "display": "Wanx/Wan 2.7", "estimated credits": 5, "score": 66, "reasons": ["ratio native", "duration fits", "cheapest"] }, "alternatives": [], "applied": { "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "9:16", "preference": "balanced" } } Reason codes: ratio native , duration fits , references supported , audio supported , cheapest , highest quality , mock provider ; the UI localizes them. Endpoint: POST /api/v1/shots/{shot id}/model-recommendation . Choosing “Auto” on the shot page refreshes the recommendation as duration, ratio, references or preference change, and estimate plus generation reuse the same provider/model so the model never switches silently. GET /providers/models also exposes each model's modes , max duration , ratios , max references , supports audio , credits per second and quality tier . 2.3 Model discovery The catalogue has three sources: 1. Static catalogue for accurate labels, capabilities and cost baselines. 2. CLI discovery : at startup pippit-tool-cli model and kling --quiet who am i contribute the models those CLIs actually expose (including new ones); Pippit draft preview models are skipped for now. 3. Model Studio discovery : the OpenAI-compatible /models endpoint (191 models at the time of writing) adds the image models it exposes (for example wan2.7-image , wan2.7-image-pro ). qwen-image- and z-image- use other image APIs and are not wired yet). That endpoint does not list video models, so the video catalogue stays curated here. Results are cached for ten minutes and any source failure falls back to the catalogue already available; GET /providers/models merges all three so the UI picks up new models without code changes. Set VIDEOAGENT CLI MODEL DISCOVERY ENABLED=false to disable CLI discovery. 3. Mock provider Used for offline development, unit tests and Playwright E2E; it never bills anyone. - Config: VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=mock - Behaviour: submit returns mock-<uuid , polling succeeds immediately against a bundled sample. - Limits: it does not reproduce real provider timeouts, quotas or error codes. 4. Pippit provider The server owns the Pippit CLI session, so browsers only see VideoAgent sessions. VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=pippit VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND=pippit-tool-cli VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL= VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION= VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT TIMEOUT SECONDS=180 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY= CI only; prefer the browser login - Submit: generate-video with prompt, duration, ratio, model and multimodal references. - Poll: query-result --thread-id --run-id ; the task id is a JSON reference to both fields, so jobs survive restarts. - Account: GET /providers/pippit for status, GET /providers/pippit/credits for balance. - Errors: missing binary → 503 , not logged in → 409 , upstream failure → 502 . - CLI compatibility (1.0.57+) : query-result requires --download-dir and generate-video requires an explicit --resolution (720p by default). Results prefer the CLI-downloaded output path because download url can return 403. The two-phase Seedance 2.5 draft preview flow is not wired yet, so that model is hidden. 5. Kling provider Two backends selected by VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND : VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND=cli cli mcp VIDEOAGENT KLING CLI COMMAND=kling VIDEOAGENT KLING CLI TIMEOUT SECONDS=180 VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID= pins the authorized China-region account - cli : runs @klingai/cli-cn ; best for developer machines and single-host deploys. - mcp : connects to https://klingai.com/mcp with the current user's OAuth token, encrypted at rest by provider credentials and never exposed to the browser. - An unconnected account without fallback returns 409 KLING NOT CONNECTED . - kling who am i and kling account provide read-only identity and credit checks. 5.1 Connect MCP (OAuth) The MCP backend uses the current user's encrypted token, not a shared server credential: 1. GET /api/v1/providers/kling/connect registers a client (or uses VIDEOAGENT KLING OAUTH CLIENT ID ), creates PKCE material and a single-use oauth flows row valid for ten minutes, then returns authorization url . 2. Complete the Kling consent in the browser. GET /api/v1/providers/kling/callback?code&state validates the state and expiry, exchanges the code, encrypts the tokens into provider connections and redirects 303 back to the frontend. 3. GET /api/v1/providers/kling reports connection state; DELETE disconnects. 4. The admin Runtime card exposes the same flow through “Connect Kling account”. State is single-use; expired, replayed or mismatched requests return 400. 6. Wanx provider (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / Tongyi Wanx) Pure HTTP with asynchronous tasks: submit returns a task id , polling returns video url . VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=wanx VIDEOAGENT WANX API KEY=sk-... VIDEOAGENT WANX BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com VIDEOAGENT WANX MODEL=wan2.6-t2v VIDEOAGENT WANX TIMEOUT SECONDS=300 - Same region is mandatory : key, endpoint and model must match; workspace domains look like https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com . - Clamped parameters : duration 2–15s; ratios 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4 only, so a project's 21:9 falls back to 16:9. - Image-to-video : public URLs pass through; local references are base64 data URIs, so very large images should go through OSS and a public URL instead. - Result URLs expire after 24 hours : materialize generation result downloads and persists them immediately. - Model aliases : WANX MODEL ALIASES maps labels such as Wanx/Wan 2.6 to model ids. - Unit tests use httpx.MockTransport and cover submission, status mapping, error codes and local image encoding. Image models use two endpoints: wan2.7-image / wan2.7-image-pro call the synchronous /api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation ; wanx2.1-t2i-turbo uses the asynchronous /api/v1/services/aigc/text2image/image-synthesis . Both support text-to-image only today; pick a Kling image model for reference-image generation. 7. Planner and vision review (LLM provider) Both are OpenAI-compatible: switch vendors with base url , api key and model . DeepSeek (default) VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL=deepseek-flash Qwen VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL=qwen-plus Vision review VIDEOAGENT VISION BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 VIDEOAGENT VISION MODELS=["qwen-vl-max"] - Without a key the deterministic local planner runs; nothing is called silently. - A remote planner timeout or unparsable answer falls back locally and is reported in the agent trace. - Visual review only runs on an exported film; with no evaluator configured the UI says so instead of inventing scores. 8. Media storage VIDEOAGENT MEDIA STORAGE=local local oss VIDEOAGENT MEDIA DIR=.data/media VIDEOAGENT OSS ENDPOINT= VIDEOAGENT OSS BUCKET= VIDEOAGENT OSS ACCESS KEY ID= VIDEOAGENT OSS ACCESS KEY SECRET= VIDEOAGENT OSS PREFIX=videoagent - local : the media directory is the durable copy; this is the default. - oss : writes are mirrored (uploads, generated images, generated videos, exports, covers) and reads restore on a cache miss. FFmpeg always works on local files. - Run cd services/api && uv sync --extra oss first; missing credentials raise a StorageError rather than silently degrading. 8.1 Create the bucket and a RAM user Do not use the root account AccessKey. Production and team environments should use a RAM user restricted to one bucket and prefix. 1. Enable OSS and create a bucket: - Same region as the API and Model Studio (for example oss-cn-beijing ). - Access control: private — the app proxies downloads through its own API. - Static website hosting is not required. 2. Create a RAM user: RAM console → Users → Create User, tick "OpenAPI access", generate an AccessKey only (no console password). 3. Attach a custom least-privilege policy scoped to the prefix this repository uses: { "Version": "1", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["oss:PutObject", "oss:GetObject", "oss:DeleteObject"], "Resource": ["acs:oss: : :your-bucket/videoagent/ "] } ] } 4. Fill group 4 in .env and run cd services/api && uv sync --extra oss . 5. Verify with uv run --project services/api python scripts/check-oss.py ; it performs a put → get → delete round trip and prints the bucket and endpoint. Notes: when ECS and the bucket share a region, the internal endpoint ( https://oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com ) avoids public traffic; local development must use the public endpoint. Only static AK/SK are supported today; STS is not wired yet. 9. Adding a provider 1. Implement name / estimate / submit / status under providers/ . 2. Register the mode in providers/factory.py and, for per-user auth, in services/provider resolver.py . 3. Add a VIDEOAGENT -prefixed setting and an empty example in .env.example . 4. If model aliases are needed, extend the alias table and the Provider/Model regex in api/generation.py . 5. Write contract tests with MockTransport or a fake CLI; never require a paid call. 10. Known limits - Live Wanx, Kling MCP and Pippit runs need real keys or sessions; CI only runs contract tests. - The OSS backend is unit-tested against a fake SDK, not a live bucket in CI. - Wanx cannot produce 21:9; crop at export time instead of relying on the provider. References: DashScope OpenAI-compatible API, Wanx text-to-video API, OSS Python SDK

text: VideoAgent 模型文档 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.0 更新日期 2026-11-21 范围 视频生成 Provider、规划器与视觉评审、媒体存储、配置与排查 本文件是 Provider 相关内容的唯一入口：视频生成、LLM、视觉评审和媒体存储都在这里说明， 不再分散到各文档。 1. 总览 Provider 接入方式 能力 鉴权 配置前缀 --- --- --- --- --- mock 进程内 文生视频、图生视频（本地样例素材） 无 — pippit CLI 子进程 文生/图生视频、任务查询、积分余额 服务端 CLI 登录 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT kling CLI 或 MCP 文生/图生视频、动作控制、多模态参考 国内版 CLI OAuth 或用户 MCP Token VIDEOAGENT KLING wanx HTTP（DashScope） 文生/图生视频、多镜头叙事 服务端 API Key VIDEOAGENT WANX 规划器与视觉评审走 OpenAI 兼容协议（DeepSeek、通义千问等），媒体存储有 local 与 oss 两种后端。所有凭据只来自环境变量或 .env ，不进入代码和仓库。 2. 选择与解析顺序 1. VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER 决定默认 Provider（ mock / pippit / kling / wanx ）。 2. 项目 Brief 中的 Provider/模型 标签（如 Wanx/Wan 2.6 ）优先于默认值。 3. 前端在估算或生成时显式提交的 provider 再次覆盖。 4. mock 模式直接返回 Mock Provider，不访问任何外部服务。 5. auto 模式下，Kling 未连接且允许降级时回退到 Mock，并如实告知用户。 2.1 模型目录与前端选择 模型不再写死在前端： GET /api/v1/providers/models 返回统一目录 （ provider / model / label / display / kind ），工作区的视频与图片选择器在挂载时拉取， 接口不可用时回退到打包时的目录。项目 Brief 里的 Provider/Label 标签也通过同一份目录解析。 运营可以在不改代码的情况下调整目录： 追加模型（JSON 数组，kind 为 video 或 image） VIDEOAGENT EXTRA MODELS=[{"provider":"wanx","model":"wan2.2-t2v-plus","label":"Wan 2.2 Plus"}] 隐藏默认模型（按 model id 或 "Provider/Label"） VIDEOAGENT DISABLED MODELS=["kling-video-v2 5"] 静态落地页（GitHub Pages）没有 API，仍使用打包目录作为回退。 2.2 自动推荐（Auto） 创作框的 Auto 不在项目创建时决定模型；到镜头阶段由用户填写选项，服务端按选项推荐： 输入 说明 --- --- generation mode 文生视频 / 图生视频 duration seconds 1–30 秒 aspect ratio 16:9 / 21:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 等 reference image count 参考图数量 audio enabled 是否需要音频 preference budget / balanced / quality 路由先按能力硬过滤（模式、时长上限、原生比例、参考图槽位、音频、Provider 是否可用）， 再按偏好加权打分（预算、画质档位、参数贴合度），返回首选与候补： { "recommended": { "provider": "wanx", "model": "wan2.7-t2v", "display": "Wanx/Wan 2.7", "estimated credits": 5, "score": 66, "reasons": ["ratio native", "duration fits", "cheapest"] }, "alternatives": [], "applied": { "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "9:16", "preference": "balanced" } } 理由码： ratio native 、 duration fits 、 references supported 、 audio supported 、 cheapest 、 highest quality 、 mock provider ；前端按当前语言渲染。 接口： POST /api/v1/shots/{shot id}/model-recommendation 。镜头页选择「自动推荐」后， 时长、比例、参考图或偏好变化会实时刷新推荐，估算与生成复用同一个 provider/model ， 不会静默换模型。 GET /providers/models 同时返回每个模型的 modes 、 max duration 、 ratios 、 max references 、 supports audio 、 credits per second 、 quality tier 。 2.3 模型发现 目录有三个来源： 1. 静态目录 ：准确的标签、能力与价格基线； 2. CLI 发现 ：启动时运行 pippit-tool-cli model 和 kling --quiet who am i ， 把 CLI 实际开放的模型（含新模型）并入目录，Pippit 的 draft 样片模型暂不纳入； 3. 百炼发现 ：调用 OpenAI 兼容 /models （当前返回 191 个模型）补充 图像模型 （如 wan2.7-image 、 wan2.7-image-pro ）。 qwen-image- 、 z-image- 走其他图像 接口，暂未接入。该接口 不返回视频模型 ， 视频目录仍由本文件维护。发现结果缓存 10 分钟，任一来源失败都静默回退到已有目录； GET /providers/models 合并三部分，前端无需改代码即可看到新模型。可用 VIDEOAGENT CLI MODEL DISCOVERY ENABLED=false 关闭 CLI 发现。 3. Mock Provider 用于离线开发、单元测试和 Playwright E2E，不产生费用。 - 配置： VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=mock - 行为：提交返回 mock-<uuid ，轮询立即成功并指向仓库内置样例视频。 - 限制：不验证真实 Provider 的时限、配额和错误码。 4. Pippit Provider 服务端持有 Pippit CLI 的登录态，浏览器只拿到 VideoAgent 自己的会话。 VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=pippit VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND=pippit-tool-cli VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL= VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION= VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT TIMEOUT SECONDS=180 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY= 仅 CI 使用，优先浏览器登录 - 提交： generate-video ，携带提示词、时长、比例、模型与多模态参考文件。 - 查询： query-result --thread-id --run-id ， task id 是这两个字段的 JSON 引用，可跨重启恢复。 - 账号： GET /providers/pippit 读状态， GET /providers/pippit/credits 读余额。 - 错误：CLI 缺失 → 503 ；未登录 → 409 ；上游失败 → 502 。 - CLI 兼容（1.0.57+） ： query-result 必须带 --download-dir ， generate-video 必须显式 --resolution （默认补 720p）。结果优先使用 CLI 下载的 output path （ download url 可能 返回 403）。 Seedance 2.5 draft 的两阶段样片流程尚未接入，目录暂不提供该模型。 5. Kling Provider 两种后端，由 VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND 选择： VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND=cli cli mcp VIDEOAGENT KLING CLI COMMAND=kling VIDEOAGENT KLING CLI TIMEOUT SECONDS=180 VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID= 固定已授权的国内版账号 - cli ：调用国内版 @klingai/cli-cn ，适合开发机和单机部署。 - mcp ：用当前用户的 OAuth Token 连接 https://klingai.com/mcp ，Token 由 provider credentials 加密存储，不落浏览器。 - 未连接且不可降级时返回 409 KLING NOT CONNECTED 。 - 可用 kling who am i 与 kling account 做只读核对。 5.1 连接 MCP（OAuth） MCP 后端使用 当前用户 的加密 token，不是服务端共享凭据： 1. GET /api/v1/providers/kling/connect ：动态注册客户端（或使用 VIDEOAGENT KLING OAUTH CLIENT ID ）、生成 PKCE、写入 10 分钟有效的一次性 oauth flows ，返回 authorization url 。 2. 浏览器打开该地址完成可灵授权，回调 GET /api/v1/providers/kling/callback?code&state ： 校验 state/过期、交换 token、加密写入 provider connections ，然后 303 回到前端。 3. GET /api/v1/providers/kling 查看连接状态， DELETE 断开连接。 4. 管理后台 Runtime 卡片的「Connect Kling account」按钮已接同一流程。 state 一次性使用；过期、重放或 provider 不匹配都会返回 400。 6. Wanx Provider（阿里云百炼 / 通义万相） 纯 HTTP，异步任务：提交拿 task id ，轮询取 video url 。 VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER=wanx VIDEOAGENT WANX API KEY=sk-... VIDEOAGENT WANX BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com VIDEOAGENT WANX MODEL=wan2.6-t2v VIDEOAGENT WANX TIMEOUT SECONDS=300 - 地域必须一致 ：API Key、Endpoint、模型跨地域会失败；业务空间专属域名形如 https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com 。 - 参数收敛 ：时长夹到 2–15 秒；比例只接受 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4，项目的 21:9 回退为 16:9。 - 图生视频 ：公网图片 URL 原样传递；本地参考图编码为 base64 data URI，超大图建议先传 OSS 再传 URL。 - 结果 24 小时失效 ： materialize generation result 立即下载并转存到媒体存储。 - 模型别名 ： WANX MODEL ALIASES 把 Wanx/Wan 2.6 、 Wanx/Wan 3.0 Prime 等标签映射到 模型 ID。 - 单测使用 httpx.MockTransport ，覆盖提交、状态映射、错误码和本地图片编码。 图像模型分两套接口： wan2.7-image / wan2.7-image-pro 走同步的 /api/v1/services/aigc/multimodal-generation/generation ； wanx2.1-t2i-turbo 走 /api/v1/services/aigc/text2image/image-synthesis 异步任务。两者目前都只支持 文生图 ， 参考图生图请选择 Kling 图片模型。 7. 规划器与视觉评审（LLM Provider） 两者都是 OpenAI 兼容接口，改 base url + api key + model 即可切换厂商。 DeepSeek（默认） VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL=deepseek-flash 通义千问 VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL=qwen-plus 视觉评审 VIDEOAGENT VISION BASE URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 VIDEOAGENT VISION MODELS=["qwen-vl-max"] - 不配置 Key 时使用确定性的本地 Planner，不会静默调用外部模型。 - 远程 Planner 超时或返回不可解析结果时，回退本地 Planner 并在 Agent 轨迹中说明。 - 视觉评审只对已导出的成片运行；未配置评估器时明确提示，不伪造分数。 8. 媒体存储 VIDEOAGENT MEDIA STORAGE=local local oss VIDEOAGENT MEDIA DIR=.data/media VIDEOAGENT OSS ENDPOINT= VIDEOAGENT OSS BUCKET= VIDEOAGENT OSS ACCESS KEY ID= VIDEOAGENT OSS ACCESS KEY SECRET= VIDEOAGENT OSS PREFIX=videoagent - local ：媒体目录即持久层，默认行为。 - oss ：写入时镜像（上传、生成图、生成视频、成片、封面），读取缺失时回源；FFmpeg 始终 处理本地文件。 - 启用前先 cd services/api && uv sync --extra oss ；缺凭据抛 StorageError ，不静默降级。 8.1 创建 Bucket 与 RAM 子账号 不要用主账号 AccessKey。 生产与团队环境用 RAM 子账号，权限限定到 Bucket + 前缀。 1. 开通 OSS，创建 Bucket： - 地域与 API/百炼一致（例如北京 oss-cn-beijing ）。 - 读写权限选 私有 ——应用通过自己的 API 代理下载，不需要公共读。 - 不需要开启静态网站托管。 2. 创建 RAM 用户：控制台 → RAM 访问控制 → 用户 → 创建用户，勾选「OpenAPI 调用访问」， 只生成 AccessKey，不创建控制台登录密码。 3. 给该用户绑定自定义策略（最小权限，只覆盖本仓库使用的前缀）： { "Version": "1", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["oss:PutObject", "oss:GetObject", "oss:DeleteObject"], "Resource": ["acs:oss: : :your-bucket/videoagent/ "] } ] } 4. 填 .env 第 4 组，执行 cd services/api && uv sync --extra oss 。 5. 验证： uv run --project services/api python scripts/check-oss.py 会做一次 put → get → delete 往返，并打印 Bucket 与 Endpoint。 补充：ECS 与 Bucket 同地域时可用内网 Endpoint （ https://oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com ）省流量；本地开发必须用公网 Endpoint。 当前只支持静态 AK/SK，尚未接入 STS 临时凭证。 9. 新增一个 Provider 1. 在 providers/ 实现 name / estimate / submit / status 四个成员。 2. 在 providers/factory.py 注册模式，必要时在 services/provider resolver.py 处理用户级鉴权。 3. 在 config.py 用 VIDEOAGENT 前缀增加配置，并在 .env.example 留空示例。 4. 如果支持模型别名，加入 api/generation.py 的别名表与 Provider/模型 正则。 5. 用 MockTransport 或 Fake CLI 写契约测试，不依赖真实付费调用。 10. 已知限制 - Wanx、Kling MCP、Pippit 的真实联调需要各自的 Key 或登录态，CI 只跑契约测试。 - OSS 后端仅对假 SDK 做过单测，未在 CI 上跑真实 Bucket。 - 万相不支持 21:9；需要 21:9 时请在导出阶段裁切，而不是依赖 Provider。 参考：DashScope OpenAI 兼容接口、 万相文生视频 API、 OSS Python SDK

Purpose This guide describes the VideoAgent implementation architecture, module boundaries, runtime flow, provider adapters, and engineering conventions. 2. System Scope - Next.js App Router product UI. - Left navigation: Agents, Skills, Videos, Assets, Docs. - Home composer with Skill and Hook selectors, six production playbooks, and transparent custom dropdowns. - Auto-growing prompt textarea with idea suggestions rendered only in the empty state. - Complete live video-model catalogue with provider-labelled Pippit, Kling, and Wanx options. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue using user id/skill id , plus user publishing. - Searchable Videos feed with looping video playback, Skill-backed scenario reuse, and publishing. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs, permission, and yyyy-mm-dd edit date; videos preview on hover, Skill cards have no cover, and cards do not repeat type labels. - Searchable bilingual Docs with nine documents, a collapsible table of contents, and full-text lookup across languages. - Registration, login, logout, server-side sessions, and user isolation. - Project create, list, read, rename, and archive. - Storyboard read and whole-document replacement. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - OpenAI-compatible and deterministic local planners. - Cost estimate and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI, China-region Kling CLI, Wanx (DashScope), and Mock Provider adapters. - Celery polling with Redis. - Per-user credit reservations and idempotent refunds. - Image, video, and audio uploads with MIME, signature, and size validation. - FFmpeg composition with landscape, vertical, and square deliveries, captions, soundtrack, and cover generation. - Private asset downloads plus time-limited, revocable share links. - Same-origin write validation and separate auth, generation, and upload limits. - An environment-allowlisted administration console for accounts, credits, jobs, invites, runtime switches, and audit logs. - Live production progress and Final Cut visual evaluation. - CI, security scanning, documentation generation, and release builds. - Playwright and Mock Provider end-to-end acceptance without paid generation. 3. Repository Layout VideoAgent/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ │ │ ├── messages/ EN/ZH translation resources │ │ ├── public/docs/ generated English and Chinese Docs │ │ ├── src/app/ Next.js routes and API proxy │ │ ├── src/components/ product UI and project workspace │ │ ├── src/i18n/ next-intl routing │ │ └── tests/ ├── packages/landing/ │ ├── src/index.tsx shared product UI │ ├── src/content.ts English and Chinese content │ └── src/landing.css shared visual system ├── services/api/src/videoagent/ │ ├── agent/ graph and planner │ ├── api/ FastAPI routes │ ├── providers/ Pippit, Kling China CLI, Mock │ ├── services/ storyboard, jobs, evaluation │ └── workers/ ├── docs/ paired Markdown sources ├── scripts/build pages.py Markdown and static Docs builder └── .github/workflows/ 4. Runtime Browser ├── Next.js :3000 │ ├── /api/account/ → FastAPI :8000/api/v1 │ └── /docs/ → generated HTML FastAPI ├── SQLite by default ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling China CLI Celery Worker ├── Redis broker └── Pippit query-result The browser account and home creation requests use the Next.js Route Handler. The project workspace uses NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL . 5. Request Flows 5.1 Authentication register/login → normalize email → hash password with Argon2 → create opaque session token → store SHA-256 token hash → set HttpOnly SameSite cookie 5.2 Storyboards PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard replaces the complete shot list, increments Storyboard.version , and assigns contiguous shot indexes starting at zero. The same replacement persists recurring Character resources and Shot resources. Character generation uses the domestic Kling CLI text to image and image to image tools, validates project-owned image references, reserves credits, and persists the downloaded image as a project asset. 5.3 Agent POST /projects/{project id}/messages → persist user message → assemble bounded Context and short-term Memory → record context / memory / Skill activity → resolve persisted Skill instructions when available → execute LangGraph plan storyboard → validate StoryboardPlan → record planning / validation activity → replace storyboard → record state activity → persist assistant message → record reply activity → return both messages and current storyboard The workspace polls GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} at 350ms and renders the durable event stream as its live Agent trace. 5.4 Generation estimate → POST /shots/{id}/estimate generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → provider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → enqueue Celery polling status → GET /jobs/{id} → refresh from Provider when non-terminal 6. The product app keeps the landing shell mounted and opens conversations as the hash view /en conversation/{project id} . Project detail pages are not exposed as separate routes; creating, selecting, or returning to a conversation does not trigger a document navigation. 8. Skills Implementation Skills is one flat searchable catalogue. Cards show user id/skill id and preload actionable prompts into the Agents composer. Provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace, while cross-provider workflows use video agent : video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same card form as other task-oriented Skills. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own namespace. Public Skills are included in the catalogue for other signed-in users. GET /skills returns likes , uses , is liked , and is mine . Repeated likes and uses are represented by unique rows in skill engagement likes and skill engagement usages , so the same account cannot inflate a leaderboard. The frontend computes uses × 2 + likes × 3 , keeps category filters separate from overall rank, and renders the top-three reward projection. Videos has the equivalent hots likes record, with rank based on unique likes. Production playbooks are defined in packages/landing/src/content.ts with a prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. Applying one updates the full composer draft; clicking the active playbook again restores the saved pre-playbook composer state. Videos cards carry a Skill ID so scenario reuse enters Agents with the matching Skill selected. 9. Documentation Localization The globe control switches documentation language. English: product-requirements.html Chinese: product-requirements.zh.html The same pattern applies to all nine documents in this order: PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. Security - Argon2 password hashing. - Opaque session tokens with SHA-256 storage. - HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax cookies. - Ownership checks on projects, shots, and jobs. - Pippit credentials remain server-side. - Kling OAuth state remains inside the MCP connector boundary. - CLI calls use argument arrays and timeouts. - Secret and dependency scanning run in CI. - Unsafe methods validate Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site . - Uploads enforce byte limits and validate declared MIME plus file signatures. - Share tokens are stored as hashes and become unavailable after expiry or revocation. - Collaboration tokens create project membership only after authenticated acceptance. View-only membership is enforced by project mutation endpoints. - Administration access is restricted by VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Disabling a user immediately revokes existing sessions. - The generation kill switch blocks both estimation and Provider submission. 13. Playwright uses the Mock Provider for generation and therefore never consumes real Provider credits.

验证审批、生成、导出、分享、Skill 优化，以及 Videos 视频上传和 Assets 详情，不访问付费 Provider。 - 管理测试覆盖白名单权限、积分调整、账号停用、邀请码、注册关闭和生成开关。 - 普通 CI 不执行付费生成。 新增功能必须遵循： 1. 先编写失败测试。 2. 实现最小代码。 3. 重构。 4. 运行相关测试和全部质量门禁。 16. 开发规范 16.1 后端 - 路由层只处理 HTTP 转换和依赖注入。 - 领域逻辑放在 services/ 。 - Provider 细节只放在 providers/ 。 - 所有外部输入由 Pydantic 校验。 - API 错误使用稳定错误码。 - 不能把 Pippit Access Key 或 CLI 登录文件写入日志。 - 新查询必须包含用户所有权条件。 16.2 Agent - LLM 输出必须使用 Pydantic 结构化模型。 - 不在 Agent 中直接执行删除、支付或账号操作。 - 外部生成操作必须经过明确的计费审批。 - Prompt 中上传内容和用户文本均视为不可信。 - 本地规划器必须保持可用，确保无模型环境可以开发。 16.3 Provider - 所有 Provider 实现 VideoProvider 接口。 - Provider 错误必须转换为稳定的业务错误。 - 生成提交禁止无幂等保护地重试。 - 查询失败可以退避重试。 - 原始响应与标准化响应分开保存。 16.4 前端 - 服务端状态使用 TanStack Query 或页面级异步加载。 - 临时交互状态使用 React state/Zustand。 - 新文案必须同时进入 en.json 和 zh-CN.json 。 - 优先使用语义标签和可访问控件。 - 动效必须支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - Pippit 凭据不得进入 localStorage 或浏览器状态。 17. 扩展点 新增视频 Provider 1. 实现 VideoProvider 。 2. 将 Provider 错误映射为领域错误。 3. 增加 Provider Contract 测试。 4. 在 Provider Resolver 中增加选择逻辑。 5. 增加前端能力展示和积分字段。 新增 Agent 节点 1. 在 AgentState 中增加类型化状态。 2. 为该状态迁移编写单元测试。 3. 将节点加入 StateGraph 。 4. 保持节点幂等。 5. 涉及外部长任务时交给 Celery，不在图节点内阻塞等待。 新增 API 1. 在 schemas.py 增加输入输出模型。 2. 在 services/ 增加业务逻辑。 3. 在 api/ 增加薄路由。 4. 增加所有权和未授权测试。 5. 更新本文档和 OpenAPI 调用方。 19. 提交流程检查清单 - 功能有对应失败测试和通过测试。 - 新接口包含鉴权与资源所有权校验。 - 新文案中英文 Key 一致。 - 没有提交 .env 、Token、上传媒体或本地数据库。 - Ruff、mypy、pytest、TypeScript、Vitest 和 Next Build 通过。 - 新增外部依赖已写入锁文件。 - 新增配置已写入 .env.example 。 - 设计或实现边界变化已更新本文档。

text: VideoAgent Test Document Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.6 Updated 2026-11-06 Frameworks pytest, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright 1. Purpose This document defines the automated test strategy, contracts, quality gates, and acceptance checks for the VideoAgent system. 2. TDD Rules 1. Add one failing behavior test. 2. Implement the smallest change that passes. 3. Refactor without changing public behavior. 4. Run all relevant quality gates before commit. Tests assert public behavior, API contracts, ownership, state transitions, and user-visible outcomes rather than private implementation details. 3. Test Layers Unit and component tests → Provider and API contract tests → SQLite integration tests → Playwright and Mock Provider browser E2E External paid generation is never part of normal CI. 4. Coverage Backend: - Password hashing and session behavior. - Project ownership, rename, and archive. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Agent planning with deterministic and fake LLM behavior. - Mock, Pippit, Kling, and Wanx Provider contracts. - Estimate, approval, idempotency, and job status. - Provider status and credits. - Health endpoint. - Instant storyboard evaluation. - Media MIME, signature, size, and ownership validation. - FFmpeg composition, delivery, cover generation, sharing, expiry, and revocation. - User credit reservation, failure refunds, and idempotent ledger entries. - Same-origin write validation and authentication rate limiting. - Administrator email allowlists and non-admin denial. - User disablement, session revocation, and credit adjustment. - Invite creation, consumption, revocation, and registration modes. - Generation kill switch, job refunds, and audit logs. - China-region Kling CLI submission, status mapping, identity, and credits. - Public Skill discovery, like toggling, de-duplicated uses, and author self-like rejection. - Videos like toggling, account de-duplication, persistence, and removal. Frontend: - Shared landing structure and navigation. - Sequenced and looping hero headline. - Search composer and custom settings dropdowns. - Project creation flow. - Assets, Videos, and Docs view switching. - Assets permission, date, hover preview, and cover behavior. - Videos author, likes, playback, and publishing. - Skill and Videos category filters, leaderboard order, and like interaction; individual cards show neither rank nor reward. - English-to-Chinese Docs switching. - Project list, authentication form, and project workspace. - Project uploads, film export, MP4 download, and share-link creation. - Administration console loading, settings changes, and denied access. 5. Provider Contract Tests Every VideoProvider verifies: - Provider name is stable. - Estimate returns normalized credits and duration. - Submit returns a stable task reference. - Status maps to pending , submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , or cancelled . - Errors do not expose credentials or full sensitive command arguments. - The same idempotency key does not submit twice. Pippit tests use a local fake CLI and cover status, credits, submit, query, timeout, missing binary, invalid JSON, and missing task IDs. Kling tests use a fake MCP client and cover text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, task-state mapping, and result extraction. Wanx tests use httpx.MockTransport to cover async submission, status mapping, error codes, and local reference-image encoding without touching DashScope. Media storage tests use a fake oss2 module to exercise the OSS path; local storage remains the default. 6. API Tests Required assertions: - Authentication and ownership. - Response status and schema. - Stable error codes. - Explicit generation approval. - Idempotency behavior. - Storyboard replacement ordering. - Shot IDs, generated assets, and history remain intact after reordering. - Agent message persistence. - Production progress percentage and Final Cut visual-review response shape. - No provider credentials in responses. 7. Frontend Tests Component tests cover: - Left navigation with isolated views. - Custom dropdown rendering and selection. - Action button enabled and disabled states. - Videos metadata order: title above author and likes. - Every Videos card contains an autoplaying muted looping video. - Publish entry uses the blue play icon. - Skills is one searchable catalogue with user id/skill id labels; provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace. - Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review settings. - Re-clicking the active playbook restores the prior composer state. - Videos scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill and prompt. - The textarea grows with multiline content, and idea suggestions disappear while the prompt contains non-whitespace text. - The Model selector includes every available Kling and Pippit video model in Provider/Model format. - Docs labels are PRD , Playbook , Arch , API , Dev , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . - Docs opens PRD by default; search sits above the left document directory, which matches expanded navigation width and supports resizing or collapse. - Globe control changes Docs source and language. - Skills, Videos, Assets, and Docs search controls stay pinned while content scrolls. - Assets switches between Video and Skill tabs without repeating type labels. - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Composer menus stay inside the viewport. - Conversation history shows Projects and Recents; folders support creation, rename, deletion, and drag-to-file organization. - Dragging a Recent into a project folder persists the relationship, removes the item from Recents, and renders it as an indented folder child. - Selecting a conversation updates only the URL hash and preserves the mounted application shell; no document navigation occurs. - The workspace tree exposes peer Directions , Visions , and Versions groups; legacy Storyboard, Media, and Exports groups are absent. Projects, Recents, and their conversation items remain text-only. - Characters and Scenes own their descriptions and uploaded references; each Shot opens one combined page. Empty directories do not render waiting copy. - Settings renders Q&A as question-answer attribute rows without the retired lower stage cards. - Settings extracts semantic Attribute / Value clues and excludes approval decisions instead of rendering raw Q&A text. - Settings, Outlines, Scripts, Shot, Character, and Scene editors persist changes through their project or resource endpoints. - Uploads append @<asset-id to the active Prompt; generation infers image-to-video or image-to-image from that reference. - Shots may override task type, audio, and resolution, and requests preserve the Prompt order of multiple @asset-id references. - Uploaded and generated results appear under their directory with a persisted final-selection checkbox, copy-ID, preview, and delete action. - Desktop panes default to equal widths and expose draggable separators. - The profile popover contains an inline Languages row with vertically stacked options plus notifications and credits above the avatar and username trigger; account actions carry icons and the gear remains inside the avatar row. - Browser titles are exactly VideoAgent ; the administration runtime label is Pippit China . - Assets and Agents collapse independently and restore from their labeled rails. - The editor header renders no production progress bar and no storyboard “Review” score button. - Character and Scene pages support uploaded, reference-image, and text image generation, with generated images stored as downloadable project assets. - Storyboard snapshots are immutable and support listing and restore. - Restore preserves the Shot ID at the same index, and exported results live under Visions / FinalCuts . - Final Cut review is available only for exported assets, lets the user choose a configured vision evaluator and consistency metrics, and is unavailable when no evaluator is configured. - Export is blocked until every storyboard Shot has a generated result. - A conversational instruction such as “Render the final cut” triggers delivery generation; no separate render button is exposed in the editor. - Existing deliveries can create a new 21:9, 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 version with a soundtrack or voice-over and line-by-line captions. - Shot estimation and generation return 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED until the storyboard has at least one Character and one Scene. - Model selectors appear on Character and Shot pages, default to the project configuration, and send explicit task-level overrides. - Project sharing creates a collaboration link with view/edit access and an optional email restriction; accepted collaborators can open the project. - An exported final cut can be published to Videos without uploading it again. - Videos use the film-reel icon everywhere; Skills use the camera icon. - Shot generation displays an approval requirement until the story workflow reaches the approved state. - Persisted Agent messages render statically; only a newly returned reply uses the type-on effect and does not replay after the Agents rail is reopened. - Agent requests show a live execution trace, with the compact Thinking spinner retained as the initial fallback before events arrive. - Agent requests persist ordered context , memory , skill , planning , validation , state , and reply events under the client-provided run ID. - The Agents panel renders those events as a live execution trace and remains accurate when a Skill or MCP tool was not called. - Context Builder uses at most eight prior messages, clips each to 600 characters, excludes the current request, and caps Storyboard context at 20 Shots. - Stage approval options cover overall direction, episode and shot outline, and scene script; custom instructions keep the current stage. - Shot estimation and generation remain disabled until the script is approved. - Character Generation supports upload, image-to-image, and text-to-image; generated images are persisted as downloadable project assets. - Skill Studio captures purpose, instructions, quality gates, starter prompt, and input/output contracts. - AI optimization converts a rough idea into a structured draft, and saved Skills reload from the server. - video agent/skill synthesis opens Skill Studio directly. - The app navigation collapses to an icon-only rail, and signed-in Agents views list recent conversations. - Videos publishing requires an MP4 and the post appears in the author's Assets. - Skill and Videos order remains stable across category filters, and like buttons toggle state while updating the displayed count. Cards show category after the title without rank or earned-credit labels. - Assets video and Skill cards open detail dialogs, with video playback. - Workflow approvals advance immediately, and Agent language follows the project brief and user prompt. - Long briefs are split into directing attributes; the English workspace omits Chinese examples and no longer uses Creative brief or Director direction as fallback labels. - Login and registration use the same dark visual language as the product. - Projects opens the project form from its plus action; Recents starts a new Agents conversation; both groups remain collapsible. - Pippit normalizes sub-four-second requests and surfaces provider failures while refunding reserved credits. - Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. - Docs is positioned beside the fixed navigation and its document iframe loads without being covered by decoration or background layers. - Avatar opens login and registration when signed out and sign-out when signed in. - API starts with its metadata table. - FAQ and TODO have paired English and Chinese documents. Playwright uses the real Next.js UI, FastAPI service, SQLite, and Mock Provider to verify: register → home prompt → create project → three approvals → upload references → generate every shot → collaboration link → render final cut → download/share → publish An additional no-fee Skill flow verifies: register → Skills → rough idea → AI optimize → publish → reload The no-fee Videos and Assets flow is: register → Videos → upload MP4 → publish → Assets → open details and play This flow never calls a paid Provider and is a required Pull Request gate. The administration E2E covers administrator sign-in, console loading, and generation pause. Backend integration tests cover non-admin 403 responses, credit adjustments, account disablement, invite registration, and audit logs. 8. Responsive and Accessibility Checks - Keyboard access for navigation, dropdowns, Docs, and dialogs. - Visible focus states. - Sufficient text size and contrast. - Reduced-motion support. - Desktop sidebar and mobile navigation remain usable. - Long English and Chinese text do not overlap. 9. CI Gates Pull requests must pass: Ruff check and formatting mypy strict checks pytest Vitest TypeScript check Next.js production build Docs and static artifact build Playwright with Mock Provider E2E secret and dependency scans 10. Provider Verification Read-only 1. Install and authenticate pippit-tool-cli . 2. Run status and get-credit-balance . 3. Query /providers/pippit and /providers/pippit/credits . 4. Verify logs omit access keys. 5. Verify China-region Kling CLI who am i confirms authorization, account region, and model discovery. Authorized paid generation Only with explicit user approval and budget: 1. Record starting credits. 2. Submit one minimal task. 3. Verify the idempotency key and Provider task reference. 4. Poll to completion. 5. Record result, credits, and UI/API consistency. 6. Do not automatically retry an uncertain submission. 11. Definition of Done - Tests were written before implementation or alongside a documented regression case. - Relevant local tests pass. - Ruff, mypy, TypeScript, Next build, and Docs build pass. - No secrets, local databases, or generated media are committed. - API and UI documentation are updated when behavior changes. - Paid Provider tests remain opt-in.
